name: gea-dotcom#lang
description: This cookie is used to store language preferences, to serve up content in the stored language.

name: GEA_COUNTRY
description: This cookie stores the ISO country code of the visitor's (detected) country to show information which refers to the visitor's location.

name: CLID
description: Identifies the first-time Clarity saw this user on any site using Clarity.

name: ai_user
description: This cookie name is associated with the Microsoft Application Insights software, which collects statictical usage and telemetry information for apps built on the Azure cloud platform. This is a unique user identifier cookie enabling counting of the number of users accessing the application over time.Used to track usage of the embedded video player.

name: countryCode
description: This cookie stores the ISO country code of the visitor's (detected) country to show information which refers to the visitor's location.

name: _clck
description: Persists the Clarity User ID and preferences, unique to that site is attributed to the same user ID.

name: MUID
description: This is a Microsoft cookie that contains a GUID assigned to your browser. It gets set when you interact with a Microsoft property, including a UET beacon call or a visit to a Microsoft property through the browser.

name: MR
description: This is a Microsoft cookie that contains a binary flag. It gets set when you interact with a Microsoft property, including a UET beacon call or a visit to a Microsoft property through the browser.

name: SRM_B
description: This cookie enables personalized user experience by adapting collected user data to their specific user or device preferences. It can also track users' behavior beyond the loaded website. Unique identifier for a visitor used by Microsoft Advertising.

name: SM
description: Used in synchronizing the MUID across Microsoft domains.

name: MUID
description: Identifies unique web browsers visiting Microsoft sites. These cookies are used for advertising, site analytics, and other operational purposes.

name: MR
description: This is a Microsoft cookie that contains a binary flag. It gets set when you interact with a Microsoft property, including a UET beacon call or a visit to a Microsoft property through the browser.

name: ANONCHK
description: Indicates whether MUID is transferred to ANID, a cookie used for advertising. Clarity doesn't use ANID and so this is always set to 0.

name: _uetsid
description: This contains the session ID for a unique session on the site. Note: As of as of July 2023, _uetsid has been updated with additional parameters as follows: insights_sessionId, timestamp, pagenumber, upgrade, upload.

name: _uetvid
description: UET assigns this unique, pseudoanonymized visitor ID, representing a unique visitor. UET stores this data in a first-party cookie. Note: As of as of July 2023, _uetvid has been updated with additional parameters as follows: insights_userId, cookieVersion, expiryTime, consent, cookie_creation_time.

name: _ga_HR58EJYFMP
description: Used by Google Analytics to identify and track an individual session with your device.

name: ai_session
description: This cookie name is associated with the Microsoft Application Insights software, which collects statistical usage and telemetry information for apps built on the Azure cloud platform. This is a unique anonymous session identifier cookie.

name: _clsk
description: Connects multiple page views by a user into a single Clarity session recording.

name: ad_session_id
description: Technical cookie used to load balance traffic between servers.

name: uuid
description: Stores a unique identifier for current visitor, used for authentication to for example webinars and gated videos. When a workspace has Analytics cookies enabled, this cookie is remembered across sessions and used to build usage information across visits.

name: _gcl_au
description: Used by Google AdSense for experimenting with advertisement efficiency across websites using their services For more information about Google's processing of your personal data, please consult Google's Privacy & Terms site.

name: __cf_bm
description: The __cf_bm cookie is a cookie necessary to support Cloudflare Bot Management, currently in private beta. As part of our bot management service, this cookie helps manage incoming traffic that matches criteria associated with bots.

name: lidc
description: This domain is owned by LinkedIn, the business networking platform. It typically acts as a third party host where website owners have placed one of its content sharing buttons in their pages, although its content and services can be embedded in other ways. Although such buttons add functionality to the website they are on, cookies are set regardless of whether or not the visitor has an active Linkedin profile, or agreed to their terms and conditions.  For this reason it is classified as a primarily tracking/targeting domain.
